# AI Film Studio

A Muse agent skill for explicit-only AI film-production planning: concept grill, film brief, production records (assets, performance, geography), model-neutral shot prompt packets built with bin/film_advisor.py, and iteration supervision. It plans and drafts — it never starts a live generation, upload, purchase or publication on its own; those need explicit approval. Ported from a community plugin.
